#en: Almost good to go, but we can't leave yet. We've gotta get a ship in your fleet first. Otherwise, we risk Watchtower catching us off guard.
zh: 差不多可以出发了，但我们还不能走。得先给你的舰队添一艘飞船。否则，我们就有被瞭望塔打个措手不及的风险。

#en: We're just about ready! But first, assign a ship to your fleet, or we'll be sitting ducks...
zh: 我们差不多准备好了！但首先，给你的舰队指派一艘飞船，否则我们就只能坐以待毙……

#en: We're almost good to go, but first, we need to assign a ship to your fleet. Otherwise we'll be vulnerable to Watchtower.
zh: 我们差不多可以出发了，但首先，我们需要给你的舰队指派一艘飞船。否则我们会很容易被瞭望塔拿下。

#en: Relax, we're in the clear! It's all been taken care of already. Even brought back a Slate packed with intel...
zh: 放心，我们没事！全都已经办妥了。还带回了一块装满情报的数据板……

#en: Nothing to worry about there! We already handled it. And, even snagged an Intel Slate full of interesting info...
zh: 没什么可担心的！我们已经处理好了。而且还弄到了一块装满有趣信息的情报数据板……

#en: Ah, no need to worry! We've already dealt with that. Even recovered an Intel Slate with some juicy data...
zh: 啊，不用担心！我们已经处理了。还找回了一块载有劲爆数据的情报数据板……

#en: Now, use the terminal here -- and "Commission" Sledgeback to your fleet.
zh: 现在，用这里的终端——把"碎背"编入你的舰队。

#en: Ships yours. Its name's Sledgeback. Keep it until you no longer need it.
zh: 船归你了。它叫"碎背"。用到你不再需要为止。

#en: Don't worry about me. The ship's more useful to you right now.
zh: 别担心我。现在这艘飞船对你更有用。

#en: Well... Wasn't planning on leaving the station anytime soon, so -- should be fine.
zh: 嗯……我近期也不打算离开空间站，所以——应该没问题。

#en: You're friends with Torin. That's reason enough.
zh: 你是托林的朋友。这就够了。

#en: Let's head back to Stardock. Harper and Gren will wanna hear what went down.
zh: 我们回星坞吧。哈珀和格伦会想知道发生了什么。

#en: What are these...? Computer Cores?! Hm. Well! Alright, I think we got what we need.
zh: 这些是什么……？计算机核心？！嗯。好吧！行，我想我们需要的东西都拿到了。

#en: Hey, this salvage looks promising... Looks like we recovered a slate with some Intel, got some Watchtower Components, and... huh.
zh: 嘿，这批战利品看着不错……看来我们找回了一块带情报的数据板，还有些瞭望塔组件，还有……嗯。

#en: Don't worry, though! They won't be able to overwhelm us. With two ships in our fleet, we should be okay.
zh: 不过别担心！他们没法压垮我们。舰队里有两艘飞船，我们应该没问题。

#en: Oh no... Watchtower! How'd they-... Nevermind.
zh: 哦不……瞭望塔！他们怎么——……算了。

#en: Here we are! We should hunt down that Listening Post...
zh: 我们到了！我们该去找到那个监听哨……

#en: Looks like we found it! Readings are similar to that Watchtower Safe House we cracked open, only... smaller.
zh: 看来我们找到了！读数和我们撬开的那座瞭望塔安全屋相似，只不过……小一些。

#en: I'll stay up here and provide cover. Remember, you can always call down a Skydrop if you need it.
zh: 我会留在上面提供掩护。记住，需要的话随时可以呼叫空投。

#en: Need to gain entry to that Listening Post... Check the bodies. One of them might have a way in.
zh: 得想办法进入那个监听哨……检查尸体。他们中可能有人有进去的办法。

#en: Gotta admit, I'm also a tad curious as to what Watchtower are doing here...
zh: 得承认，我也挺好奇瞭望塔在这儿干什么……

#en: But looks like we've still got a chance to recover some data... Seems there's some sort of "broadcast array" close by...?
zh: 但看来我们仍有机会找回些数据……附近似乎有某种"广播阵列"……？

#en: Damn. Whatever intel was here is gone.
zh: 该死。这里原本无论有什么情报，都没了。

#en: Yup, I think this is the Surveillance Array we're looking for.
zh: 对，我想这就是我们要找的监视阵列。

#en: A bit difficult to tell, but... I'm fairly sure that's Watchtower hardware!
zh: 不太好判断，但……我挺肯定那是瞭望塔的硬件！

#en: Or I suppose we could just blow it up? May be able to recover the data we need from the wreckage.
zh: 或者我想我们干脆把它炸掉？也许能从残骸中找回我们需要的数据。

#en: ...Hm. Maybe try hailing it? We might be able to pull the intel we need from its memory banks, before it broadcasts.
zh: ……嗯。也许试着呼叫它？我们也许能在它广播之前，从它的存储库里提取到需要的情报。

#en: ...Doubt we'll be able to crack its encryption remotely. But maybe if we destroy it, we might be able to recover some data from the wreckage!
zh: ……我们大概没法远程破解它的加密。但也许摧毁它的话，我们能从残骸中找回一些数据！

#en: Whoa! What was that?!
zh: 哇！那是什么？！

#en: You see that energy burst? Readings say it was... some sorta unstable gravitational fold...
zh: 你看到那道能量爆发了吗？读数说那是……某种不稳定的重力褶皱……

#en: Hm. It's causing issues with some of our ship's systems... Damn. Grav jumps offline...
zh: 嗯。它正在影响我们飞船的一些系统……该死。重力跃迁离线了……

#en: The Intel Slate, when I started poking around for more specific info, the rest of the data... kinda deleted itself.
zh: 那块情报数据板，当我开始翻查更具体的信息时，其余的数据……就自己删掉了。

#en: Don't you need your ship? Are you sure you want to give it to me?
zh: 你不需要你的飞船吗？你确定要把它给我？

#en: Why are you doing all this for me? We've only just met.
zh: 你为什么为我做这些？我们才刚认识。

#en: Thanks for the ship. That's very generous of you.
zh: 谢谢你的飞船。你太慷慨了。

#en: Altair III awaits!
zh: 牵牛星III在等着呢！

#en: We should head down to Altair III, deal with this Listening Post.
zh: 我们该去牵牛星III，处理这个监听哨。

#en: You checked your sensors? There's something that looks like an array not too far off... We should investigate.
zh: 你查看传感器了吗？不远处有个看起来像阵列的东西……我们该去看看。

#en: If in doubt, blow it up! That's definitely one way to deal with that array.
zh: 拿不准就炸掉！这绝对是处理那个阵列的办法之一。

#en: Let's search that Watchtower wreckage. See if we can find Harper's intel, and some components for Gren.
zh: 我们搜索那堆瞭望塔残骸。看看能不能找到哈珀要的情报，还有一些给格伦的部件。

#en: Oh. Actually, that might--... Okay.
zh: 哦。其实，那也许——……好吧。

#en: Ugh, Torin!
zh: 呃，托林！

#en: Why is it every time we get back from a supply run, you're nowhere to be found?! Is it really that hard to stay put and not leave the station unattended?
zh: 为什么每次我们补给回来，你都不见人影？！好好待着、别让空间站无人看管就那么难吗？

#en: Pfft. Put a sock in it, Torin!
zh: 噗。闭嘴吧，托林！

#en: If you wanna give them a bloody lip, come talk to me when you have a moment. Got a job for you...
zh: 如果你想让他们吃点苦头，有空来找我。有活儿给你……

#en: And you, Torin's friend? From what I understand, you'd be no fan of Watchtower, right?
zh: 还有你，托林的朋友？据我所知，你也不喜欢瞭望塔，对吧？

#en: Apologies if I caused distress. Maybe I should remove my helmet...
zh: 如果造成困扰，我道歉。也许我该摘下头盔……

#en: This particular version, the Model 2 -- is outdated, has a number of security exploits. Making it perfect for integration with a non-Watchtower ship.
zh: 这个特定版本，2型——已经过时，存在不少安全漏洞。正好适合整合到非瞭望塔的飞船上。

#en: The Fleet-Sync Control Node -- is capable of doing the same job, but with considerably less overhead.
zh: 舰队同步控制节点——能完成同样的工作，但开销小得多。

#en: Such things are often handled by a suite of human operators, situated on command decks of large vessels.
zh: 这类事务通常由一整套人工操作员处理，他们坐镇于大型飞船的指挥甲板上。

#en: Interfleet coordination can be complicated.
zh: 舰队间的协调可能很复杂。

#en: ...Didn't know about the mechs, though. They shouldn't have been there. Someone must've changed orders at the last minute... Um, sorry.
zh: ……不过我不知道那些机甲的事。它们本不该在那儿。一定是有人在最后一刻改了命令……呃，抱歉。

#en: I was one of the last people to step foot inside before it was abandoned. Therefore, I knew it had what you and Torin needed.
zh: 在被废弃之前，我是最后进去过的人之一。所以我清楚里面有你和托林需要的东西。

#en: An off the grid outpost -- offering supplies, or refuge to traveling operatives.
zh: 一处脱离网络的哨站——为过往特工提供补给或庇护。

#en: A few years back, the facility you broke into was an active Watchtower safe house.
zh: 几年前，你们闯入的那处设施还是一座仍在运作的瞭望塔安全屋。

#en: Now, I do believe the delightful Miss Harper requested your presence! So let us visit her, post haste!
zh: 好了，我相信可爱的哈珀小姐要求你过去！那我们赶快去拜访她吧！

#en: C'mon, let's go talk to Harper.
zh: 来吧，我们去和哈珀谈谈。

#en: Let's get a move on and talk with Harper.
zh: 我们快点，去和哈珀谈谈。

#en: Harper's waiting for us, let's get moving.
zh: 哈珀在等我们，走吧。

#en: C'mon, let's go check in with Harper.
zh: 来吧，我们去向哈珀报到。

#en: Well, that's everything we needed to do here. C'mon! We should investigate that Watchtower Listening Post.
zh: 好了，这里要做的都做完了。来吧！我们该去调查那个瞭望塔监听哨。

#en: Nothing left to do here now! So, let's go deal with the Listening Post!
zh: 这里没别的事了！那我们去处理监听哨吧！

#en: We're finished here. Time to scope out the Watchtower Post!
zh: 这里完事了。该去查看瞭望塔的哨站了！

#en: We've done what we need to! Onwards to the Listening Post!
zh: 该做的都做了！向监听哨进发！

#en: I think we're good here. Let's check out the Listening Post.
zh: 我想这里没问题了。我们去看看监听哨。

#en: Before we leave, I guess I should go familiarize myself with my new ship. See you in space!
zh: 走之前，我想我该去熟悉一下我的新飞船。太空见！

#en: I'll go check out my brand new ship! See you out there.
zh: 我去看看我的新飞船！外面见。

#en: Will just need a moment to prep my vessel. See you out there!
zh: 我需要一点时间准备飞船。外面见！

#en: Just need to ready my ship. Will rendezvous with you as soon as you're good to go!
zh: 我得把飞船准备好。你一就绪我就与你会合！

#en: I'll be right with you. Just gotta do a quick inspection of my ship first.
zh: 我马上就到。先快速检查一下我的飞船。

#en: I'll join you aboard your ship. Don't feel right sending you off by yourself just yet...
zh: 我上你的飞船跟你一起。现在还不太放心让你一个人去……

#en: I'll tag along aboard your ship for now. Let's go!
zh: 我先搭你的飞船一起去。走吧！

#en: I'll be hitching a ride on your ship for now. Safety in numbers, right?
zh: 我先搭你的飞船一程。人多力量大，对吧？

#en: I'll tag along! Feels wrong to send you off into the void solo.
zh: 我跟你一起去！让你一个人进虚空感觉不对劲。

#en: I'll come with. No sense in letting you handle this alone!
zh: 我一起去。没道理让你一个人处理这事！

#en: Say no more! We've already taken care of it. That Listening Post is yesterday's news.
zh: 不用说了！我们已经处理好了。那个监听哨已是过去式。

#en: Before we get going, you should really assign a ship to your fleet. Otherwise, Watchtower can grab us whenever they want!
zh: 出发之前，你真该给舰队指派一艘飞船。否则，瞭望塔想什么时候抓我们就什么时候抓！

#en: Come with me. I wanna just run some things by you before we get moving.
zh: 跟我来。出发前我想跟你过几件事。

#en: Sorry, busy now. Come back later.
zh: 抱歉，现在正忙。回头再来。

#en: Use the Fleet Command Terminal. Should be easy to figure out.
zh: 用舰队指挥终端。应该很容易上手。

#en: Let me know how it goes with that Listening Post!
zh: 监听哨那边进展如何，告诉我一声！

#en: I think Torin and Gren want to talk with you. You should check in with them.
zh: 我想托林和格伦想跟你谈谈。你该去找他们。

#en: Not right now. You should see what Torin wants.
zh: 现在不行。你该去看看托林要什么。

#en: Gren will wanna see the equipment we recovered.
zh: 格伦会想看看我们回收的装备。

#en: Need to pass that Intel onto Harper.
zh: 得把那份情报交给哈珀。

#en: We should touch base with Harper and Gren.
zh: 我们该跟哈珀和格伦接头。

#en: Harper's waiting for you. Think she wants to talk about something.
zh: 哈珀在等你。她好像有事要谈。

#en: Should talk with Gren.
zh: 该和格伦谈谈。

#en: We should speak with Gren and Harper.
zh: 我们该和格伦、哈珀谈谈。

#en: Hey, don't look at me! Look at that fleet terminal instead.
zh: 嘿，别看我！去看那台舰队终端。

#en: Let's head back to Stardock. We can talk more once we're there.
zh: 我们回星坞吧。到了那儿再细谈。

#en: Eventually, Watchtower will spook, and start development on their Armillaries. Inadvertently giving us what we need to destroy them.
zh: 最终，瞭望塔会惊慌起来，开始研发他们的浑天仪。无意中给了我们摧毁他们所需的东西。

#en: So! I'd advise that we start building up our fleet, researching and installing Skydrops, and maybe even grabbing a few Cyberamps!
zh: 那么！我建议我们开始扩充舰队，研究并安装空投，也许再弄几个赛博增幅！

#en: Not to mention, until Watchtower start work on their Armillary device to counter us, our only option to destroy the station, would be the self-destruct.
zh: 更何况，在瞭望塔开始研制他们用来对付我们的浑天仪装置之前，我们摧毁那座空间站的唯一办法就是自毁程序。

#en: Yes, we could charge straight to Heimdall Station, and we might even make some progress, but there's too many things that could go wrong.
zh: 是的，我们可以直扑海姆达尔站，也许还能有所进展，但可能出岔子的地方太多了。

#en: Well, huzzah and hurrah! On the warpath we go! However, as eager as you might be, we're still going to need to prepare.
zh: 好啊，欢呼吧！我们踏上征途！不过，无论你多急切，我们仍然需要做准备。

#en: I could use your help, let's go.
zh: 我需要你的帮助，走吧。

#en: Honestly, I think it just comes down to how you wanna handle this!
zh: 老实说，我觉得就看你想怎么处理这事！

#en: On the other hand, there's no reason to rush. We have time on our side! Knowing how things will play out gives us breathing room.
zh: 另一方面，也没必要急。时间在我们这边！知道事情会如何发展给了我们喘息的空间。

#en: Conventional wisdom would have us get ready and prepare as soon as possible. Not a bad plan, all things considered.
zh: 按常理，我们会尽快准备好。综合考虑，这计划不坏。

#en: But, if you can find even more Computer Cores, bring them to me, and I'll see what I can do with them.
zh: 不过，如果你能找到更多计算机核心，拿给我，我看看能用它们做些什么。

#en: Now you'll have access to that Skydrop -- to install onto any of your vessels.
zh: 现在你可以使用那个空投了——可安装到你任意一艘飞船上。

#en: There. It's done. I've downloaded the relevant data.
zh: 好了。搞定了。相关数据我已下载完毕。

#en: We're all set to resume standard operations. Expand our fleet, prep for Watchtower.
zh: 我们已准备好恢复标准运作。扩充舰队，为瞭望塔做准备。

#en: Time to get organized again! We'll grow our fleet, and then face Watchtower head-on.
zh: 该重新组织起来了！我们会扩充舰队，然后正面迎战瞭望塔。

#en: Time we get back to the grind. Let's beef up our fleet and prepare for any Watchtower trouble.
zh: 该回去干活了。我们把舰队壮大起来，为瞭望塔可能带来的麻烦做好准备。

#en: Back to business, I'd say. Fleet-building time! Should help us handle watchever Watchtower throws at us!
zh: 我看该回到正事了。造舰队的时候到了！这能帮我们应对瞭望塔甩过来的任何东西！

#en: I think we're good to get back into the usual flow of things. Let's start building our fleet, and gearing up to deal with Watchtower.
zh: 我想我们可以回到正常的节奏了。我们开始造舰队，并为对付瞭望塔做准备。

#en: Nailed it once again. Good going!
zh: 又一次干得漂亮。做得好！

#en: Unity jumps seem to suit you! At this point, I think you've mastered the catchup process.
zh: 归一跳跃看来挺适合你！到这一步，我想你已经精通了追赶流程。

#en: Excellent job as always! You're a natural.
zh: 一如既往地出色！你天生就是这块料。

#en: Not bad at all! You're handling this all like a pro these days.
zh: 相当不错！这些天你处理起来就像个老手。

#en: That went well! You've really got the hang of this now.
zh: 进展顺利！你现在真的上手了。

#en: You should stay on Stardock, at least for now.
zh: 你该留在星坞，至少目前是。

#en: I concur. The more components like this that you bring me, the more things I can construct.
zh: 我同意。你带给我越多这种东西，我就能造出越多东西。

#en: Agreed. With a sufficient stock of such parts, I'd be able to produce additional equipment for you.
zh: 同意。有了足够多的这类零件，我就能为你生产更多装备。

#en: Hm. You're right. With enough components like these, I'll be able to fabricate more things.
zh: 嗯。你说得对。有了足够多的这种组件，我就能制造更多东西。

#en: Got it! I'm sure I can keep myself busy...
zh: 明白！我肯定能给自己找点事做……

#en: Alright, I'll hold down the fort. Take care out there.
zh: 好，我在这儿守着。外面保重。

#en: No problem, see you later!
zh: 没问题，回头见！

#en: I can back you up if you'd like? Just say the word.
zh: 如果你愿意，我可以支援你？你一句话的事。

#en: Should I tag along, or would you rather go solo?
zh: 我该一起去，还是你更想单独行动？

#en: You want some company, or...?
zh: 你要不要人陪，还是……？

#en: Roger that. Let's see what this galaxy has in store for us...
zh: 收到。看看这个星系为我们准备了什么……

#en: Sure thing! Let's hit the stars.
zh: 当然！我们奔向群星。

#en: You got it! Adventure awaits.
zh: 没问题！冒险在等着。

#en: Well, that's all. Don't be a stranger!
zh: 好了，就这些。别断了联系！

#en: Let's go. You'll be joining me, I assume?
zh: 走吧。我猜你会跟我一起？

#en: I'm unsure how to proceed. What would you suggest?
zh: 我不确定该怎么进行。你有什么建议？

#en: Let's take things slow and steady. I hear that wins the race.
zh: 我们稳扎稳打。听说这样能赢下比赛。

#en: Oh! Last thing, if at some point I start talking like its the very first time we're doing all this, just play along, okay? It's weird, I know. But I'll have good reason.
zh: 哦！最后一件事，如果某个时候我开始说得好像我们是第一次做这一切，你就配合一下，好吗？我知道这很怪。但我会有充分的理由。

#en: If anything comes up, I'll be in contact. Keep safe out there!
zh: 有什么情况我会联系你。外面注意安全！

#en: Not at all! I'll hang here for now.
zh: 完全不会！我暂时就在这儿。

#en: Mind if I go solo for now?
zh: 介意我暂时单独行动吗？

#en: Supply me with enough of these components, and I'll be more than willing to fabricate and install more tech to your ships, like Skydrops for example.
zh: 给我足够的这类组件，我就非常乐意制造更多科技并安装到你的飞船上，比如空投。

#en: But you were correct, I can use these. So long as I'm duplicating proprietary Watchtower tech, I'll need authentic components, like these.
zh: 不过你说得对，我确实能用这些。只要我是在仿制瞭望塔的专有科技，我就需要像这样的原厂组件。

#en: We found some Watchtower hardware we think you can use.
zh: 我们找到了一些我们认为你能用上的瞭望塔硬件。

#en: O Captain! My Captain! Our voyage begins anew...
zh: 哦，船长！我的船长！我们的航程重新开始……

#en: Naturally! I am, after all, part of your crew.
zh: 当然！毕竟我是你船员中的一员。

#en: Okay, then! Shall we get going?
zh: 那好！我们出发吧？

#en: Hey, gotta say, you did a really great job with all that!
zh: 嘿，得说一句，这些你都干得非常漂亮！

#en: Hey, for the most part, besides one or two gaffes, you did a good job with all that!
zh: 嘿，大体上，除了一两处失手，这些你都干得不错！

#en: We know what's coming. We take the fight to Watchtower now.
zh: 我们知道会发生什么。我们现在就主动出击，打上门去。

#en: I'll be sure to let you know if I start seeing warning signs of Armillary Doomsday devices being built.
zh: 如果我发现有浑天仪末日装置正在建造的迹象，一定告诉你。

#en: But we can cross that bridge when we come to it! For now, we have the ability to build a fleet and keep safe.
zh: 但船到桥头自然直！眼下，我们有能力组建舰队并保全自身。

#en: Right you are! We know at some point Watchtower will figure out what we're doing, and try to bring out the big guns...
zh: 说得对！我们知道瞭望塔迟早会弄清我们在做什么，并试图动用大杀器……

#en: The universe will find a way to balance things out, likely putting you on the losing side in the process. So, best to just do things right! We play along. Mostly.
zh: 宇宙会想办法把一切拉回平衡，而这过程中很可能把你这方置于败局。所以，最好还是按规矩来！我们配合。基本上吧。

#en: But, if you try to get smart and brute force your way through every situation, try to play the universe against itself...
zh: 但如果你自作聪明，想用蛮力闯过每一个局面，想与宇宙本身对赌……

#en: The way I see it, sure, we can take a few shortcuts now and again.
zh: 在我看来，当然，我们偶尔可以走点捷径。

#en: Anyhow! I'd say we're at a good point! We're free to either carry on as before, or, start getting ready to take out this universe's Watchtower.
zh: 总之！我觉得我们处在一个不错的节点！我们可以照旧行事，也可以开始准备干掉这个宇宙的瞭望塔。

#en: I don't see the point in playing pretend just to fit in.
zh: 我看不出仅仅为了融入而装模作样有什么意义。

#en: Supply me with more of these components, I'll do my best to build useful things for you.
zh: 多给我些这种组件，我会尽力为你制造有用的东西。

#en: If you gather additional Watchtower parts, I'll fabricate whatever you need.
zh: 如果你收集到更多瞭望塔零件，我就为你制造任何你需要的东西。

#en: Bring me more Watchtower components, and I'll make what I can for you.
zh: 给我带更多瞭望塔组件，我就尽力为你制作。

#en: I imagine we'll get better at it as time goes on. If we Unity jump again, I reckon we can do the whole "meet and greet" in half the time, at least!
zh: 我想随着时间推移我们会越来越熟练。要是再跳一次归一，我估计至少能把整套"见面寒暄"缩短一半时间！

#en: They need to be kept in the loop, be presented with what's going on, and allowed to digest it in as natural a way as possible.
zh: 他们需要知情，需要被逐步告知发生了什么，并以尽可能自然的方式消化它。

#en: I fully acknowledge, it might get a little tedious, but it's important we do it.
zh: 我完全承认，这可能会有些乏味，但我们这么做很重要。

#en: You mean walk through introductions with Gren and Harper? Everytime, I would think.
zh: 你是说跟格伦和哈珀一遍遍走介绍流程？我想每次都得这样。

#en: But why must we "play our role?"
zh: 但我们为什么必须"扮演自己的角色"？

#en: Besides, the more we change, the less predictable things become. So we should at least pretend to do things in an order that makes sense.
zh: 再说，我们改变得越多，事情就越难预测。所以我们至少该假装按合理的顺序行事。

#en: Then, if we try to break the correct sequence of things, it just complicates matters! So, best we play our roles.
zh: 然后，如果我们试图打乱正确的顺序，只会让事情更复杂！所以，最好还是扮演好我们的角色。

#en: And then, in comes us, knowing pretty much everything that'll happen, because we've seen a version of it all before!
zh: 而后，我们登场，几乎知晓将要发生的一切，因为我们见过这一切的一个版本！

#en: Because... it's just... easier! Regular folks dont want to see causality flipped on its head! It's not something they're built to handle.
zh: 因为……就是……更省事！普通人可不想看到因果关系被掀个底朝天！那不是他们天生能承受的。

#en: How many more times will we have to do this?
zh: 我们还得这样来多少遍？

#en: I know it may seem silly, playing dumb, retracing the same steps as last time...
zh: 我知道装傻、重走上次的老路也许显得很蠢……

#en: You know, "introducing" yourself with Gren and Harper, getting them up to speed, integrating yourself into their version of the universe.
zh: 你知道，跟格伦和哈珀"初次相识"，让他们了解情况，把自己融入他们这个版本的宇宙。

#en: We play along, try not to disrupt the logical flow of things too much. ...Unless, you know, it's like, really funny or something.
zh: 我们配合，尽量不过多地扰乱事情合乎逻辑的流程。……除非，你知道，那真的特别好笑之类的。

#en: We're a disruptive force! The least we can do is try to blend in and not derail the lives of innocent bystanders.
zh: 我们是一股破坏性力量！我们至少能做到的是尽量融入，不去搅乱无辜旁观者的生活。

#en: Precisely! We're already monkeying with the fabric of reality! Unity jumps, crazy gravity powers, accumulating knowledge of "future" events.
zh: 正是！我们已经在拨弄现实的经纬了！归一跳跃、疯狂的重力能力、积累关于"未来"事件的知识。

#en: I understand, Starborn stand out enough as it is.
zh: 我明白，星裔本来就已经够显眼了。

#en: But that's just what you do when jumping through Unity. You play your role, and you "follow the script". That's just how it is.
zh: 但穿过归一时就是这么回事。你扮演你的角色，你"照着剧本走"。就是这样。

#en: But you've gone through a Unity jump before, you know how it goes. You play the role you're meant to, how you're meant to. That's just how it is.
zh: 但你经历过归一跳跃，你知道是怎么回事。你扮演你该扮演的角色，以该有的方式。就是这样。

#en: I'll hold onto this core for now.
zh: 这个核心我先收着。

#en: ...I see. I have the feeling I'm not getting the full story. But whatever! You took care of the problem, and grabbed some intel too. Not bad.
zh: ……我明白了。我感觉你没把全部实情告诉我。但算了！你解决了问题，还弄到了些情报。不错。

#en: Assuming you can provide me with enough components, I'm willing to fabricate and install more Skydrops to your ships.
zh: 只要你能给我足够的组件，我愿意为你的飞船制造并安装更多空投。

#en: But yeah, I can use these. Watchtower uses proprietary hardware. As long as I'm duplicating their tech, I'll need authentic components, like these.
zh: 不过是的，我确实能用这些。瞭望塔用的是专有硬件。只要我还在仿制他们的科技，就需要像这样的原厂组件。

#en: Hah. Yep. You're a friend of Torin's, alright.
zh: 哈。对。你确实是托林的朋友。

#en: Don't worry, I know what he's like...
zh: 别担心，我知道他是什么样……

#en: Of course. If you bring me that Core, or others later, I'll be happy to extract what blueprints I can from them.
zh: 当然。如果你把那个核心带给我，或者以后带来别的，我很乐意从中提取出能提取的图纸。

#en: But, if you can find even more Computer Cores, bring them to me, and I'll see what I can do with them.
zh: 不过，如果你能找到更多计算机核心，拿给我，我看看能用它们做些什么。

#en: If that's what you prefer, here. You may have the core back. Keep hold of it for now.
zh: 如果你更愿意这样，那好。这个核心还给你。你暂时收着吧。

#en: Cores contain vast amounts of information. But, like almost all Watchtower technology, they have inbuilt safeguards...
zh: 核心中储存着海量信息。但和几乎所有瞭望塔科技一样，它们内置了防护措施……

#en: Eh, I won't ask where these came from...
zh: 呃，我就不问这些东西是从哪儿来的了……

#en: We found some Watchtower hardware, think you use this?
zh: 我们找到了些瞭望塔硬件，你觉得你能用上吗？

#en: Hurry up! We've not got all day, you know?
zh: 快点！我们可没一整天时间，你知道的？

#en: [Hand over Intel] We took care of it. Take a look at this Intel Slate we recovered.
zh: [交出情报]我们搞定了。看看我们找回的这块情报数据板。

#en: Be aware, after pulling some data, the Slate will fry itself. Watchtower's paranoid like that.
zh: 注意，读取部分数据后，数据板会自行烧毁。瞭望塔就是这么偏执。

#en: Just so you know, once you grab some info, the Slate will cook itself. Watchtower fail-safe.
zh: 先跟你说一声，你一旦提取了信息，数据板就会自毁。瞭望塔的故障保护机制。

#en: FYI, that Slate's rigged to erase itself shortly after use. Watchtower designed it that way.
zh: 提醒一下，那块数据板被设定为使用后不久即自行擦除。瞭望塔就是这么设计的。

#en: Heads up! That Slate's a one-and-done deal. You get one pass at that data. Then poof! It's kinda like a self-destruct.
zh: 注意！那块数据板是一次性的。你只有一次读取数据的机会。然后就没了！差不多就是个自毁装置。

#en: Keep in mind, the Slate will wipe itself once you pull data from it. Watchtower security feature.
zh: 请记住，你一旦从数据板中提取数据，它就会自动擦除。这是瞭望塔的安全功能。

#en: Okay, gimme a sec... Let's see what we're dealing with...
zh: 好，稍等一下……看看我们面对的是什么……

#en: Hm, let's see. Loading up the Slate...
zh: 嗯，我看看。正在加载数据板……

#en: Hm. Alright, just give me a second. I'll see what I can get from this Slate...
zh: 嗯。好，给我一点时间。看看我能从这块数据板里弄到什么……

#en: That's how Watchtower keep finding me and Torin.
zh: 瞭望塔就是这样一直找到我和托林的。

#en: Take your time, there's no rush.
zh: 慢慢来，不急。

#en: Not much useful info for you personally on there, but you'll find it reveals some interesting tidbits about Watchtower.
zh: 那上面对你个人来说没什么有用的信息，但你会发现它揭示了一些关于瞭望塔的趣闻。

#en: You'll want to run that Slate through Gren's cracking algorithm at some point.
zh: 你迟早得把那块数据板用格伦的破解算法跑一遍。

#en: However, a small snag. That Intel Slate, once you start poking around in it, it'll delete its data. It's a Watchtower security feature.
zh: 不过，有个小麻烦。那块情报数据板，你一旦开始翻查，它就会删除数据。这是瞭望塔的安全功能。

#en: An excellent idea! After all, it would be in our best interest to find and shut down more of these Arrays. Stop Watchtower from tracking us as much.
zh: 好主意！毕竟，找到并关闭更多这种阵列最符合我们的利益。让瞭望塔少追踪我们一些。

#en: I see... Then I'll be sure to give the Slate a thorough going over! Maybe we can find out which Systems Watchtower is hiding these Arrays in.
zh: 我明白了……那我一定把数据板彻底研究一遍！也许我们能查出瞭望塔把这些阵列藏在哪些星系里。

#en: That's how Watchtower found me and Torin in the first place.
zh: 瞭望塔一开始就是这样找到我和托林的。

#en: Torin exaggerates, we just got lucky.
zh: 托林夸张了，我们只是运气好。

#en: The data on there highlights how Watchtower's got Arrays all over. Almost every system...
zh: 那上面的数据凸显出瞭望塔到处都有阵列。几乎每个星系……

#en: Yup. Slate reveals how Watchtower -- have set up Arrays for intel-gathering across countless systems.
zh: 对。数据板揭示了瞭望塔——在无数星系中设立了用于收集情报的阵列。

#en: Intel. It lays out how Watchtower's Arrays -- monitor just about every system...
zh: 情报。它说明了瞭望塔的阵列——监视着几乎每一个星系……

#en: The Slate outlines Watchtower's Array network. Multiple system side coverage.
zh: 数据板概述了瞭望塔的阵列网络。覆盖多个星系。

#en: You could say that! It explains how Watchtower uses Arrays for spying. They have 'em in most systems.
zh: 可以这么说！它说明了瞭望塔如何用阵列进行监视。大多数星系里都有。

#en: Like how Watchtower tracks and flags people for capture using those Posts and Surveillance Arrays, and how they have these Arrays in most systems.
zh: 比如瞭望塔如何利用那些哨站和监视阵列追踪并标记抓捕目标，以及他们在大多数星系里都有这些阵列。

#en: You seem confident. There something good on here?
zh: 你看起来很有把握。这上面有什么好东西吗？

#en: Oh yeah? Really think this thing's worth cracking open?
zh: 哦是嘛？你真觉得这东西值得撬开看看？

#en: That so? Something on here I should see?
zh: 是吗？这上面有什么我该看的吗？

#en: Oh yeah? Like what?
zh: 哦是嘛？比如什么？

#en: That would explain how you apparently did so well.
zh: 这就能解释你为什么看起来干得那么好了。

#en: Just shut the thing down and retrieve anything useful, and I'll make sure you're rewarded properly.
zh: 把那东西关掉，回收一切有用的东西，我保证你会得到应有的报酬。

#en: Take it offline and grab whatever intel you can. You'll get paid, got my word on that.
zh: 让它离线，尽可能获取情报。你会拿到报酬，我向你保证。

#en: When you find it, shut it down and retrieve any data it's collected. I'll be really grateful, and I'll pay you for your time!
zh: 找到之后，关掉它，并取回它收集的所有数据。我会非常感激，也会为你的时间付钱！

#en: It wasn't our first rodeo, experience was on our side.
zh: 这可不是我们头一回，经验在我们这边。

#en: We're just that good!
zh: 我们就是这么厉害！

#en: Can you quickly tell me about getting back at Watchtower?
zh: 你能简单跟我说说怎么报复瞭望塔吗？

#en: Good luck, you two! Let me know how it turns out.
zh: 祝你们好运，两位！结果如何告诉我一声。

#en: Could be wrong, but me and Gren think Watchtower have set up a Listening Post in the Altair system. I want it gone.
zh: 也许我错了，但我和格伦认为瞭望塔在牵牛星星系设了一处监听哨。我想把它除掉。

#en: Long story short, me and Gren caught wind of Watchtower activity in the Altair system. A Listening Post. Frankly, it's got me worried.
zh: 长话短说，我和格伦听说牵牛星星系有瞭望塔活动。一处监听哨。坦白说，这让我很担心。

#en: In short, me and Gren noticed some kinda Watchtower Listening Post in the Altair system, and I'm concerned. I'd like some help dealing with it.
zh: 总之，我和格伦注意到牵牛星星系里有个瞭望塔监听哨，我很担心。想请你帮忙处理一下。

#en: I don't care. I'd rather save the Core for something else.
zh: 我不介意。我更想把这个核心留着用在别处。

#en: Couldn't tell you exactly where, though. You'll probably have to investigate the planet to find that out.
zh: 不过具体位置我说不准。你大概得去行星上调查才能查出来。

#en: [Hand over Intel] We recovered this Intel Slate from a Surveillance Array's wreckage.
zh: [交出情报]我们从一座监视阵列的残骸中找回了这块情报数据板。

#en: After that, do what you need to do to shut it down. Destroy any vital infrastructure they might have. We don't want them just flipping the power switch back on.
zh: 之后，用你需要的方式把它关掉。摧毁他们可能拥有的任何关键设施。我们可不想让他们随手把电闸又合上。

#en: We'll deal with this Listening Post for you.
zh: 我们会替你处理这个监听哨。

#en: We can grab any data it's collected, see what Watchtower have been poking their nose into, and then ensure the post is taken offline.
zh: 我们可以取走它收集的所有数据，看看瞭望塔在打探什么，然后确保这个哨站离线。

#en: Couldn't agree more! Tell you what, Harper. How about we go investigate this Listening Post?
zh: 完全同意！这样吧，哈珀。不如我们去调查一下这个监听哨？

#en: You don't know what a load off my shoulders that is. The Listening Post should be somewhere on Altair III.
zh: 你不知道这让我多松一口气。监听哨应该在牵牛星III上的某处。

#en: Whew, glad you're on board with this. You'll want to check out Altair III. That's where a Watchtower signal was coming from.
zh: 呼，很高兴你愿意接手。你该去牵牛星III看看。瞭望塔的信号就是从那里发出的。

#en: That's a relief to hear! You can find the Listening Post somewhere on Altair III.
zh: 听你这么说我就放心了！你可以在牵牛星III上找到那个监听哨。

#en: Perfect. Now we've got some backup if Watchtower shows up.
zh: 很好。这样瞭望塔出现时我们就有后援了。

#en: That's what I'm talking about! We can sleep easier with some fleet cover.
zh: 这才像话！有舰队掩护，我们能睡得更安稳。

#en: Good call! Now we're not sitting ducks for any opportunistic Watchtower attacks
zh: 好主意！现在我们就不会成为瞭望塔伺机袭击下的待宰羔羊了

#en: Nice! That should keep us safe for now.
zh: 不错！这暂时能保我们安全。

#en: Hey, you won't get any argument outta me!
zh: 嘿，我可不会跟你争！

#en: Would you believe that we found it by accident?
zh: 你信不信我们是碰巧发现的？

#en: Seems like something that needs dealing with.
zh: 看来这是件需要处理的事。

#en: Really? Hey, if you can do that, I'll pay for your time!
zh: 真的？嘿，要是你能做到，我会为你的时间付钱！

#en: I'll pay you for your time. A nice heap of Credits. More than enough to make it worth your while.
zh: 我会为你的时间付钱。一大笔信用点。足够让你觉得值得。

#en: So here's my proposition! I tell you where this Listening Post is, you download any data it's collected, then take it offline.
zh: 那么我的提议是这样！我告诉你这个监听哨在哪，你下载它收集的所有数据，然后让它离线。

#en: I-... What? How'd you even know to do that?
zh: 我——……什么？你怎么会知道要那么做？

#en: That seems... convenient. But I can't argue with results!
zh: 这似乎……挺方便。但我没法否认结果！

#en: I don't care if it's the Freestar Collective, pirates, or even this "Watchtower". I don't want anyone snooping around near my home.
zh: 我不管是自由星系联盟、海盗，还是这个"瞭望塔"。我不想让任何人在我家附近打探。

#en: Thanks, Gren. Any chance you could upgrade the Fleet Command system and Skydrops...?
zh: 谢谢你，格伦。有没有可能把舰队指挥系统和空投升级一下……？

#en: Not really. But if you don't wanna spill the beans, I won't push.
zh: 不太算。但如果你不想说，我不会追问。

#en: I'll think about it. You can upgrade everything, right?
zh: 我会考虑。你什么都升级得了，对吧？

#en: This Listening Post? It's not good for any of us. It's got to go.
zh: 这个监听哨？它对我们谁都没好处。必须除掉。

#en: Okay, you got a Slate. Consider me interested. Spill it, what happened?
zh: 好，你弄到了一块数据板。算我感兴趣。说吧，发生了什么？

#en: So... what's the story behind the Slate? Gonna fill me in on the details?
zh: 那么……这块数据板背后有什么故事？要不要跟我细说？

#en: An Intel Slate, huh? You care to tell me what happened out there?
zh: 一块情报数据板，是吧？愿意跟我说说外面发生了什么吗？

#en: An Intel Slate? What exactly happened out there...?
zh: 情报数据板？外面到底发生了什么……？

#en: Huh. Well, thanks! I'm impressed! Things went smooth, right? You didn't run into any trouble... did you?
zh: 嗯。嗯，谢谢！我很佩服！一切顺利吧？你们没遇到什么麻烦……吧？

#en: We found it ourselves. It's not my first time dealing with Watchtower...
zh: 我们自己找到的。这可不是我第一次跟瞭望塔打交道……

#en: Don't you worry, Harper! You'll have no problems from either of us. Cross our hearts!
zh: 别担心，哈珀！我们俩都不会给你惹麻烦。我们发誓！

#en: In other words, we're not to start too much chaos! We hear you, loud and clear!
zh: 换句话说，我们别搞出太多乱子！我们听得清清楚楚！

#en: Thus, we act accordingly! So sayth I, to thee!
zh: 所以，我们照办！我此言，谨告于你！
